name: Комбінація (7)
description: In advanced combinations, you can sometimes bring together multiple tactical themes in a single sequence of moves. This is done by combining basic tactics such as pins and double attacks or by temporarily sacrificing material to recover it with interest

examples.text: Black sacrifices a piece to create an attack against the white knight. This gains an important pawn.
The white c-pawn is pinned and therefore cannot perform its defensive duties effectively. As a result, Black wins the queen with a fork.

texts: A free rook is up for grabs!
